$comment: Pins the Windows port to the .NET 8 SDK. Without this the muxer picks the
newest SDK installed on the machine — on the GitHub runner that is .NET 10,
which built net8.0 fine but meant the workflow was not using the SDK it
installed. The `dotnet` CLI resolves global.json from the current working
directory upward, so every command must run from `windows/`.
Scoped to windows/ on purpose: the macOS SwiftPM build at the repository
root is unaffected, and no global.json exists at the root.
